title: 96% Left-Side Language Doesn't Make You Left-Brained
hook: Your 96% language tilt still cannot define your personality.
closing: Both sides cooperate, so personality never belongs to one hemisphere.
question: Were you labeled left-brained or right-brained?

segments.say: Language is 96% left-sided for right-handers, but personality does not split that way.
Of 7 tested brain networks, 0 matched the left-brain, right-brain myth.
About 200 million nerve fibers link both brain halves, keeping them in constant conversation.
